hangar.billing.v1alpha1.BillingAccountSp.description: BillingAccountSpec is the agreement. Changing the type, or the tenant's Plan while FIXED, ends the period open, in the minute the apiserver sees it, with a Statement for the part of it that has passed; the next period starts there. Any other change, and a new price of the Plan, applies from the next period.

anchorTime.description: When the first period starts, on a whole minute. Each period starts on its day of the month and its time of day, in time_zone, or on the month's last day if it has fewer. A new account's may not be before the end of its tenant's last Statement.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code the account is billed in, such as "TWD". A FIXED account's Plan, and a price list it names, must be in it.

periodMonths.description: How many months one period lasts: 1 to 6 for PAY_AS_YOU_GO; a FIXED account's is always 1, and 0 means 1 for either.

priceList.description: Name of the PriceList that rates what the tenant holds. Required for PAY_AS_YOU_GO; on a FIXED account it is optional, and only values what the tenant holds for the platform's administrators, apart from what it pays.

promotions.description: Discounts on what is billed for the time before each one's until_time, such as a trial's. Each takes its percent of what that part of a period comes to, on a line of its own; together they never take more than the period comes to. They are read as a period is billed, so a change reaches every period not billed yet.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone periods are cut in, such as "Asia/Taipei"; empty is UTC.

type.description:
BillingType is how a tenant pays.

- BILLING_TYPE_FIXED: A fee each month, whatever the tenant holds.
- BILLING_TYPE_PAY_AS_YOU_GO: What the tenant holds, minute by minute, at a PriceList's prices.

hangar.billing.v1alpha1.BillingAccountSt.description: BillingAccountStatus is the period open and what it has come to.

accrued.description: What the open period has come to so far, as its Statement would bill it, up to accrued_time.

discount.description: What the open period's promotions take off accrued, which is after them; accrued and this together are what it comes to before them.

metered.description: What the open period's holdings come to at price_list's prices, for an account that names one; for a PAY_AS_YOU_GO account, it is accrued before promotions.

periodAnchorTime.description: When the periods are counted from: anchor_time, or the minute the agreement last changed.

periodCutTime.description: Where a change of type or Plan, once seen, ends the open period; unset while none is pending.

periodOffsetMonths.description: How many months after period_anchor_time the periods of this length are cut from, once a new length took effect; they keep the anchor's day of the month.

periodStartTime.description: The period open now; unset before anchor_time.

periodType.description:
The agreement the open period started under: its type, and its fee and the Plan it came from (FIXED), or its price list, and its length.

- BILLING_TYPE_FIXED: A fee each month, whatever the tenant holds.
- BILLING_TYPE_PAY_AS_YOU_GO: What the tenant holds, minute by minute, at a PriceList's prices.

priceListVersion.description: The resource version of the price list accrued and metered were rated at; a new one rates them again.

usageLines.description: What the open period's holdings come to up to accrued_time at price_list's prices, a line for each thing held at each price, as a Statement lists them; none for an account that names no price list.

hangar.billing.v1alpha1.Promotion.description: Promotion is a discount on what an account is billed until a time.

label.description: What a statement calls it, such as "Early access": 1 to 40 characters.

percent.description: How much it takes off, from 1 to 100 percent.

untilTime.description: It discounts what is billed for the time before this, on a whole minute.

amount.description: quantity times unit_price, with six decimals.

description.description: A promotion's label, on its line, whose item is "promotion" and whose amount is negative.

item.description: What it is: "monthly_fee", a Prices field, such as "cpu", or "promotion".

priceEffectiveTime.description: When the price took effect, for a PAY_AS_YOU_GO line.

quantity.description: How much of it, in unit-hours with up to six decimals, such as "1440.5" vCPU-hours; "1" for a whole month's fee, a fraction for part.

unit.description: The unit quantity counts, such as "vCPU-hour" or "month".

unitPrice.description: The price of one unit, as the PriceList or the account gave it.

hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: BillingAccount is what a tenant has agreed to pay, and how often it is billed. Its name is the tenant's, and it goes with the tenant, after a last Statement for the period it had open. A tenant without one is not billed, and what it holds is not metered. Platform administrators keep billing accounts; the tenant's own people, at the tenant, read theirs. See docs/decisions/billing.md.
title: BillingAccount
